spanish: Y puso sobre él el joshen, y dio al joshen los urim y los tumim.

findings.issue: Common noun הַחֹשֶׁן (H2833, noun common masculine singular) is left untranslated as joshen; common nouns stay Spanish.
Common noun הָאוּרִים (H224, noun common masculine plural) is left untranslated as urim.
Common noun הַתֻּמִּים (H8550, noun common masculine plural) is left untranslated as tumim.

notes: Verbs, עלָיו, אֶל, articles, number, and object markers match; the three common nouns are transliterated.
